purpose: Exercise the full pipeline on REAL public evidence for almost no money. The octocat/Hello-World change is real: commit 7fd1a60 descends from 7629413 and adds a trailing newline.

openMissionForm.Mission title: Hello-World drill: ship the trailing newline
openMissionForm.Problem statement: The README of the frozen base ends abruptly without a trailing newline, which breaks concatenation into other documents. Repair it with a minimal patch and prove the change on the public repository.

criteria.text: After the patch, the README file ends with a trailing newline.
The patch changes only the README file and nothing else.

openMissionForm.Scope policy: Only the README file may change.
openMissionForm.Forbidden changes: No new files, no deletions, no binary assets.
openMissionForm.Evidence policy: Use only pages under github.com/octocat/Hello-World: the exact commit page and its .diff.

evidence.note: exact candidate commit on the public host

expectedFlow.artifactExamination: Likely ARTIFACT_VERIFIED — ancestry, SHA binding and diff are all real and fetchable.
expectedFlow.criterionReview: Honest judgment: the real diff only touches the README and adds the newline, so QUALIFIED is the healthy outcome; INCONCLUSIVE is also acceptable and refunds the bond.
expectedFlow.finalize: If QUALIFIED: wait the 15-minute challenge window, finalize, then withdraw ~0.0011 GEN in the Workbench.
expectedFlow.ifRejected: A REJECTED verdict is a judge-call on a drill; the 0.0001 GEN bond goes to the sponsor — that is the entire stake.
